baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb at 22:75[2], the repeated min construction, and rusulan at [5].
baseline_models.mechanism: Selection extracts a fit portion from each of two populations and turns those selected agents into carriers of a message. The verse therefore presents both discrimination and commission, not appointment alone.

activation_trace.role: Purity from admixture supplies the filtration image by which a carrier is extracted from a larger field.
Choosing the select portion supplies the explicit appointment step in the mechanism.
The messenger as bearer of a saying converts selection into a communicative office.
The explicit angel branch identifies the first population from which carriers are selected.
Manifest humanity supplies the second population and keeps the commission embodied and social.

changed_reading.before: God appoints some angels and some humans as messengers.
changed_reading.after: God filters two different populations for agents fit to carry a saying, so choosing and transmitting form one operation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Yastafi at 22:75[2] is closed by sami and basir at [10-11].
baseline_models.mechanism: Hearing as comprehension and sight as inward discernment make the closing qualities functional: the selector apprehends utterance, reception, and interior condition when distinguishing suitable carriers.

activation_trace.role: The choice of a select portion establishes the discriminating act that requires adequate knowledge.
Hearing as understanding and responsive acceptance makes audition an epistemic faculty within selection.
Insight of the heart supplies penetrating discernment rather than merely optical inspection.

changed_reading.before: Hearing and seeing are general divine attributes appended after the selection statement.
changed_reading.after: Hearing and seeing explain selection as fully informed discernment of carriers and of the reception their speech will meet.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The parallel min al-malaikati and min al-nasi phrases converge on the plural rusulan.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two source populations and the plural carrier term permit a relay model: dispatch can move through angelic and human ranks, while the branch of successive groups gives the plurality cadence rather than treating every messenger as an isolated officeholder.

activation_trace.role: Selection identifies the members admitted into the relay.
Release and dispatch supply movement from sender toward recipients.
Successive groups supply a possible cadence for the plural messengers.
Angels furnish one rank of the proposed relay.
Humans furnish the manifest social rank of the proposed relay.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists two kinds of individuals eligible for one title.
changed_reading.after: The parallel sources and plural dispatch term can describe coordinated ranks in a moving relay of communication.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sacrifice contrast separates visible material that does not reach God from guarded orientation that does. This revises the filtration baseline: yastafi can be heard as discrimination for an inwardly effective quality, while hearing-as-understanding and heart-sight prevent the criterion from collapsing into visible status.

activation_trace.role: Purification from mixture anchors the focus reading of discriminating what is effective from its exterior vehicle.
Comprehending hearing supplies access to meaningful response rather than external display alone.
Inward sight supplies discernment of the disposition carried beneath visible form.
Attaining or reaching supplies the explicit test that separates a non-reaching exterior from a reaching quality.
Literal flesh supplies one visible sacrificial vehicle declared unable to reach God.
Literal blood supplies the second material vehicle excluded from effective reaching.
Putting oneself under protection supplies the inward guarded orientation that does reach.

structural_cues: 22:37 repeats the same reaching verb on both sides of a flesh-and-blood versus taqwa contrast.
22:75 places discriminating selection immediately under paired faculties capable of exceeding surface appearance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the reaching contrast and the focus supplies selection plus discerning faculties; I infer that the contrast can specify what selection values. A live alternative is that 22:37 concerns ritual acceptance only and the closing attributes in 22:75 do not encode a criterion.

changed_reading.before: Selection identifies privileged members of two populations.
changed_reading.after: Selection can filter for an inward orientation that genuinely reaches its addressee, rather than for the carrier's visible material or rank.

context_deltas.mechanism: The travel-and-perception passage distinguishes ears that understand, eyes that remain physically intact, and hearts that become blind. It strongly activates sami and basir in the focus as integrated cognitive and moral discernment governing both selection and subsequent reception.

activation_trace.role: Choosing a select portion anchors the act whose epistemic depth is being clarified.
Understanding and compliance make divine hearing pertinent to meaningful reception.
Insight of the heart makes divine sight pertinent to inward condition.
The heart as the inner faculty localizes understanding and blindness below the sensory surface.
Intellect that restrains ignorance turns the ear's activity into accountable understanding.
Contextual hearing means understanding and response, directly activating the focus epithet.
Blindness of heart supplies the failure mode that mere optical capacity cannot repair.
Literal eyes remain unblind, providing the surface faculty from which inward sight is distinguished.

structural_cues: 22:46 coordinates hearts, ears, eyes, understanding, and blindness in one contrast.
22:75 pairs hearing and seeing after selection rather than before an unrelated clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a distinction between sensory operation and heart-level apprehension; I infer that the same root pair in 22:75 characterizes the depth of divine selection and oversight. A live alternative is that sami and basir remain unrestricted attributes with no special selection function.

changed_reading.before: The selector hears sounds and sees persons completely.
changed_reading.after: The selector comprehends response and sees inward capacity, so messenger choice is framed by heart-level rather than merely sensory knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger sequence in 22:52-53 contains dispatch, intrusive casting, removal with replacement, stabilization, and a resulting test. That sequence activates the purity branch of yastafi processually: selection does not have to mean that communication encounters no interference; it can initiate a watched channel in which interference is exposed and corrected.

activation_trace.role: Purity from admixture anchors the focus-side image of filtration.
The bearer of a saying anchors the vulnerable communication event back in the focus.
Dispatch and being sent place the correction sequence inside a messenger process.
Casting supplies an intrusive addition entering the communication event.
Removal followed by a substitute supplies the corrective filtration step.
Making firm and exact supplies stabilization after correction.
Testing metal or person turns the interference into an assay of receivers.

structural_cues: 22:52 orders messenger, casting, removal, and confirmation as successive operations.
22:53 converts what was cast into a test, while 22:54 differentiates receivers by knowledge and heart response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a corrected messenger event; I supply the arrow from that correction back to yastafi as ongoing filtration around the selected carrier. A live alternative is that the sequence concerns only audience testing and says nothing about the mechanism of selection.

changed_reading.before: Selecting a messenger means choosing an intrinsically uncontaminated conduit whose transmission admits no disturbance.
changed_reading.after: Selection can establish a monitored conduit whose communication may meet disturbance but is actively filtered, corrected, and made firm.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night entering day and day entering night are closed by the same hearing-seeing pair as the focus; the sky is then held from falling except by permission. These cues activate the angel-human selection as authorized passage across distinct domains: dispatch crosses a boundary without becoming uncontrolled collapse.

activation_trace.role: Angels anchor the upper or unseen side of the proposed domain relation.
Manifest humans anchor the embodied social side of the proposed domain relation.
Dispatch supplies controlled movement between sender and recipient domains.
One thing entering another supplies a model of boundary crossing without erasing the two sides.
The repeated hearing epithet explicitly couples awareness to the domain-entry image.
The repeated seeing epithet explicitly couples visibility to the domain-entry image.
Holding and restraining supply governance of vertical movement.
Falling and settling supply the uncontrolled movement that is withheld.
Permission supplies authorization as the condition for a legitimate crossing.

structural_cues: 22:61 and 22:75 end with the identical hearing-seeing pair.
22:65 stages heaven, earth, restraint, falling, and permission shortly before selection from angels and humans.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies controlled interpenetration and permission-governed vertical movement; I infer an analogy to dispatch across the angel-human distinction. A live alternative is that these are independent cosmological signs and should not spatialize messenger selection.

changed_reading.before: Angels and humans are simply two taxonomic pools of candidates.
changed_reading.after: Their selection can image authorized communication across distinct domains, where dispatch is permitted movement rather than uncontrolled descent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, signs are sounded in recitation, rejection becomes legible on faces, reciters face attempted violence, news is announced, and people are commanded to listen. The focus pair sami basir therefore binds the selected messenger's audible output and the audience's visible reaction into one accountable field.

activation_trace.role: The bearer of a saying anchors the acoustic and social event in messengerhood.
Auditory apprehension registers the selected carrier's recited output.
Optical apprehension registers embodied audience response.
One sound following another supplies the audible continuity of recitation and reciter.
Recognition from an outward trace makes inward rejection readable in visible signs.
The face provides the visible surface on which hostile reception appears.
A delivered report extends the messenger event from recitation into announced consequence.
The command to listen as understanding turns audience hearing into an accountable response.

structural_cues: 22:72 moves from recited signs to recognizable facial reaction and an attempted assault on the reciters.
22:73 commands listening, and 22:75 closes messenger selection with hearing and seeing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an audible-visible reception scene; I infer that the focus attributes guarantee that both testimony and reaction remain known and accountable. A live alternative is that the attributes only certify God's general knowledge and do not specifically accompany exposed reciters.

changed_reading.before: Hearing and seeing certify that God knows whom to select.
changed_reading.after: They also encompass the whole messenger event: spoken sign, heard response, visible resistance, and the accountability of those who threaten its carriers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent parable tests false objects by creation, recovery, and the weakness of seeker and sought; the next verse says God's capacity was not properly measured and names divine strength. Selection and dispatch in 22:75 then function as enacted capacity: unlike inert objects, God can identify, send, hear, and see through a real communicative relation.

activation_trace.role: Effective choosing supplies the first positive act after the incapacity test.
Actual dispatch supplies motion and agency absent from the false objects.
Presenting and making a comparison visible establishes the capacity test.
The stated parable provides the comparative frame rather than an isolated claim.
Extraction from another's possession supplies the failed recovery test.
Lack of strength diagnoses both sides of the false communicative relation.
Seeking and sought supply the two failed poles against which sender and messenger are contrasted.
Capacity that reaches effective action names what the preceding worshippers failed to measure.
Strength gathered like strands of a cord supplies the positive capacity immediately before selection.

structural_cues: 22:73-75 is an uninterrupted sequence from incapacity, to mismeasured divine capacity, to selection and perception.
The weak seeker-sought pair is answered by an effective selector-carrier relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the failed agency test and the immediate strength claim; I infer that messenger selection is the next enacted contrast. A live alternative is that 22:75 merely begins a new topic after the anti-idolatry parable.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports a neutral personnel decision after an unrelated parable.
changed_reading.after: Selecting and dispatching responsive carriers demonstrates the very sovereign capacity that the inert seeker-sought relation lacks.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus selection is followed by another explicit choosing, then a messenger-over-community and community-over-humanity witness grammar, and finally an instruction to hold fast. Selection therefore propagates responsibility: the chosen messenger is not the terminal recipient of privilege but a link that produces further witnesses while attachment preserves the chain.

activation_trace.role: Choosing the select portion anchors the first commission in the sequence.
The message-bearer supplies the middle link through which responsibility can pass onward.
Choosing and drawing near supplies a second selection applied to the addressed community.
The messenger as bearer of a saying occupies the first witness position over the community.
Presence with witnessing supplies the repeated relation from messenger to community and community to humanity.
Declaration grounded in knowledge turns presence into transmissible testimony.
Manifest humanity supplies the widening audience over whom the community bears witness.
Holding that prevents loss supplies preservation of the commissioned witness chain.

structural_cues: 22:75 and 22:78 use two different selection verbs within four verses.
22:78 repeats witness syntax across messenger, addressed community, and humanity, then commands attachment to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel choices and a nested witness relation; I infer that the later communal commission extends rather than merely follows the focus selection. A live alternative is that divine choice of messengers and choice of the community are separate honors without a single relay mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Selection terminates in a small class of privileged messengers.
changed_reading.after: Selection initiates a cascading witness commission in which the messenger forms witnesses who in turn address wider humanity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the selected-share branch carries a ruler-and-spoils register into messengerhood. It remains anchored in the supplied branch for yastafi, the two source cohorts, and the sovereignty branch of m-l-k; downstream prose should mark it as a lexical ownership image, not a legal claim about spoils or persons.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yastafi at 22:75[2] takes representatives from each named population and makes them rusulan.

activation_trace.role: A ruler's specially reserved portion supplies the odd image of emissaries claimed for a particular commission.
Sovereignty supplies the authority under which the reserved representatives belong to the mission.
Message-bearing converts the reserved portion from possession into assigned service.

changed_reading.before: Selection is only preference among candidates.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the selected messengers are a sovereign's specially claimed portion from each host, reserved for communicative service.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a sensing branch of the supplied mapping from n-w-s to hamz-n-s beneath the ordinary word for people. It remains visibly anchored by that packet mapping and by the adjacent hearing-seeing pair; downstream prose should present it as root-play, not as the settled derivation or lexical meaning of al-nas.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The human source term at 22:75[7] stands beside sami and basir at [10-11].

activation_trace.role: Perceiving something by sight, sensation, or hearing supplies an embodied sensing resonance within the human cohort.
Auditory perception echoes one modality activated inside the mapped human root.
Visual perception echoes the other modality activated inside the mapped human root.
Selection turns the sensory resonance into a tentative claim about embodied carriers rather than a free theme.

changed_reading.before: Humans are merely the second biological class from which messengers come.
changed_reading.after: As contained root-play, humans are the perceptible and perceiving rank, selected to carry a message through embodied hearing and sight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the successive-herds branch is distant from the conventional messenger noun. It remains anchored in rusulan as a plural, the repeated min phrases, and an attested branch of the same root; downstream prose should qualify it as a cadence analogy rather than assert literal batches or chronology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The plural rusulan at 22:75[5] receives selected members from two parallel source phrases.

activation_trace.role: Successive groups supply a pulsed cadence for the plural dispatch.
Release and sending keep the cadence tied to actual dispatch.
The angelic population supplies one source stream for the proposed pulses.
The human population supplies the other source stream for the proposed pulses.

changed_reading.before: Plural messengers are an undifferentiated set of officeholders.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the plural carries a cadence of selected dispatches arriving in successive groups from two source streams.

strongest_changes: The 22:52-54 sequence revises static purity into a monitored transmission that can expose, remove, and stabilize interference.
The 22:72-75 sequence turns hearing and seeing into an accountable sensorium spanning recited speech, visible rejection, and threatened carriers.
The 22:78 witness grammar extends selection into a cascading commission from messenger to community to wider humanity.
The adjacent incapacity parable makes selection and dispatch an enacted contrast to a weak seeker-sought relation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus joins filtration, two source populations, message-bearing, and paired perceptual qualities in one short sentence. Context repeatedly reactivates those parts as correction, reception, authorization, and delegated witness, so several mechanisms coexist without requiring one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The closing hearing-seeing pair may explain selection specifically or may remain a general divine-knowledge formula.
The correction sequence of 22:52 may illuminate yastafi itself or only what happens after a messenger has already been selected.
The cross-domain model and the three root-side outliers are analogical activations and should not be promoted to lexical certainties.
